statements.because: The request's user is the caller used by the explicit permission check.
The explicit view_document permission check is evaluated on the resolved root document.
This is the permission passed to has_perms_owner_aware.
The URL pk is loaded as request_doc, including its owner and root_document.
The effective document selected after authorization is passed to serve_file.
A non-null user lacking owner-aware view_document permission on root_doc takes the forbidden branch.
Failure of the owner-aware root-document permission check returns HTTP 403 before effective version selection and file serving.
When the URL identifies a non-root version and no version parameter is supplied, that request document itself becomes the effective file document.
After the permission branch, serve_file returns the selected effective document's original or archive representation.
